text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I am terribly sorry.
Due to an oversight on our part,
a double booking occurred...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I would be very glad if you feel that way.
Please accept my sincere apologies for this matter.
Yes. Goodbye, then—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you as always for your continued support.
My name is Daiichi Ruby.
Regarding our appointment for this afternoon—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Did some kind of unexpected trouble occur?
Daiichi Ruby was constantly making calls in all directions, looking utterly burdened with worries.
